scope: Proposition 4.1 (Uniform refinement of the grid) of the manuscript “A Gepner stability condition on every smooth quintic threefold” (preprints/A-Gepner-stability-condition-on-every-smooth-quintic-threefold-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 055 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f70b73596fffb068), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is an open square Ω1 about zero, contained in Ω, such that Dα 3 ⊂ Dβ 0 [1] (α, β ∈ Ω1). (4.3) For k ∈ Z and η ∈ Ω1, define V η k = Φm Uη[j], k = 2m + 5j. (4.4) This is independent of the integers m, j chosen, and these bounded aisles satisfy V α k+1 ⊂ V β k , V η k+5 = V η k [1], ΦV η k = V η k+2, k ∈ Z, α, β, η ∈ Ω1. (4.5)
